results.title: History as Therapy: A Novel Interdisciplinary Framework for ...
results.content: While these approaches foster meaning-making within clients’ familiar frameworks, HT broadens the process by immersing individuals in historical worldviews, prompting a deeper reevaluation of personal assumptions and enabling a more expansive shift in perspective than contemporary interventions alone. For HT to function as a practical psychotherapy and self-development tool, historical knowledge should be presented in a structured yet accessible manner, such as through “historical cases.” A historical case is a curated set of period-specific materials—including historical context, primary texts, scholarly interpretations, and recommended reflective exercises—designed to immerse individuals in the worldview of a past era or culture and organized as hermeneutic resources for analysis and self-inquiry. By encouraging individuals to explore and compare their individual worldviews, behaviors, and values with those of historical cultures, HT broadens perspectives and provides alternative frameworks for understanding personal challenges.

results.title: Interdisciplinary Science Rankings 2026: results analysis ...
results.content: ### **Find your university in the Interdisciplinary Science Rankings 2026**. The Interdisciplinary Science Rankings – a project in association with Schmidt Science Fellows – was created to improve scientific excellence and collaboration between universities and aims to help institutions benchmark their interdisciplinary scientific work. Like last year, the ranking, which includes 911 universities from 94 countries or territories, uses 11 metrics to measure university performance in three areas: inputs (funding); process (measures of success, facilities, administrative support and promotion); and outputs (publications, research quality and reputation). However, this year, in response to university engagement and feedback, the interdisciplinary scope has been broadened to cover any research project that comprises multiple scientific disciplines, or one or more scientific disciplines combined with one or more of the following non-STEM disciplines: social sciences, education, psychology, law, economics, or medical and health. Number of ranked universities increases by more than 20 per cent, while definition of interdisciplinary science also broadens.
